context.transcript:
Hi, everyone.
Today we have some urgent business to attend to.
I just received word that Moon-Hee Lee will be making a visit to our store tomorrow.
For those of you who don't know, Ms. Lee is our regional manager who oversees five stores in the area including this one.
Now, it's very important that we give her a good impression, so I'm requesting that everyone can see the store.
It's interesting that everyone stay a bit late today to help get the store cleaned and organized.
And, since you'll be working extra hours today, you can each select a morning to take off next week.
Just let me know which day you choose to come in later, so I can update the schedule.
context.transcript_translation:
大家好。
今天我们有一些紧急事务需要处理。
我刚接到消息说 Moon-Hee Lee 明天会来我们店视察。
对于不知道的人，Lee 女士是我们负责该地区五个门店的区域经理。
现在，非常重要的是我们要给她留下一个好印象，所以我要求大家都能看到店铺。
很高兴大家今天能多待一会儿，帮忙把店面打扫和整理一下。
而且，由于你们今天会加班，下周每个人都可以选择一天休假。
只要告诉我你选择哪天来晚点上班，我就可以更新日程表了。
